title: ChatAtom: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics Simulation and Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2611.26782v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation resolves atomic-scale motion and predicts the structural, mechanical, and dynamic properties of materials, making it cen- tral to materials design and discovery. Yet an MD study requires an expert-driven workflow: designing the simulation, writing reliable input scripts, executing them, and analyzing the results with separate tools. Here we present ChatAtom, a multi-agent large language model system that translates a natural-language request into a complete MD workflow without the user writing input scripts or analysis code. Each agent has a defined responsibility within the workflow. An orchestrator plans the study; the LAMMPS and OVITO agents each use a generator-reviewer pair to prepare and review simulation and visualization scripts before execution; a high-performance computing agent dispatches jobs to remote resources; and an analysis agent interprets the completed run. translated_title: ChatAtom：用于分子动力学模拟与可视化的多智能体大语言模型系统
translated_abstract: 分子动力学（MD）模拟可以解析原子尺度的运动，并预测材料的结构、力学与动力学性质，因而是材料设计与发现的核心手段。然而，一项MD研究通常需要专家驱动的工作流程：设计模拟方案、编写可靠的输入脚本、执行模拟，并借助多种独立工具分析结果。本文提出ChatAtom，这是一个多智能体大语言模型系统，能够将自然语言请求转化为完整的MD工作流程，用户无需编写输入脚本或分析代码。每个智能体在工作流程中承担明确的职责：编排者负责规划整个研究；LAMMPS与OVITO智能体各自采用“生成器-审查器”配对机制，在执行前准备并审核模拟与可视化脚本；高性能计算智能体负责将作业分发至远程计算资源；分析智能体则解读已完成的模拟运行结果。该工作流程可访问……
tldr: ChatAtom是一个多智能体大语言模型系统，可将自然语言请求自动转化为完整的分子动力学模拟工作流程，涵盖方案规划、脚本生成与审核、高性能计算任务分发以及结果分析与可视化，无需用户编写任何代码。
en_tdlr: ChatAtom is a multi-agent LLM system that turns natural-language requests into complete molecular dynamics workflows—covering study planning, script generation and review, HPC job dispatch, and result analysis and visualization—without requiring users to write any code.
